technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with long-term bullish structure, but severe short-term bearish alignment, weak trend strength, and lack of momentum confirmation make this a poor swing entry despite potential mean-reversion setup.

fundamental.summary: LMT shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contract visibility, and earnings arriving in 18 days creating elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (16/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal and mixed with no conviction from senior members; lack of recent news sentiment limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (339.36) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational revenues, and earnings event in 18 days compounds volatility risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9-period) combined with long-term EMA bullish alignment and supertrend signal creates textbook mean-reversion setup with price near support at 349.84, offering asymmetric risk/reward for contrarian positioning in fear-driven market.
debate.key_bear_argument: Earnings event in 18 days, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (339.36), price below all major moving averages, zero momentum confirmation, weak trend strength (ADX), and complete absence of smart money/insider conviction create unacceptable event and macro risk that overwhelms technical oversold conditions.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme RSI oversold (9-period) and long-term EMA bullish structure present textbook mean-reversion setup at support. However, earnings in 18 days, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, and zero smart money conviction create unacceptable event and macro risk that overwhelms technical opportunity.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 18 days combined with inverted yield curve and VIX crisis (339.36) creates binary event risk that can gap through technical support regardless of oversold conditions.

decision.portfolio_note: Already holding LMT with 24 existing Industrials positions (14% sector concentration); adding to existing position during earnings window and macro stress violates concentration and event-risk discipline.
